panels.sample_scope: Supplementary Fig. 16 | Observational coverage and reference-state diagnostics. a, Number of independently paired SID contributing at each departure-relative time for the six primary quantities. The six count curves coincide at every relative time. b, Pressure-level coverage of the fixed geographical domain, using the common above-ground and finite-field mask across all 1088 source times. c, Dry-APE reference coefficient c at the 13 supplied pressure levels. d, Saved mean absolute dry-hydrostatic mismatch relative to the fixed reference scale of the hydrostatic pressure gradient. Lines and shading in b–d are medians and observed minima–maxima across the corresponding stored SID or event summaries, not confidence intervals. Panel c uses a logarithmic horizontal axis to retain the full positive coefficient range. Reference means use the main 1024 times; the fixed mask uses their union with the shifted input. These diagnostics describe source and numerical support without asserting physical budget closure. Tables S7l,m give the underlying summaries.
